title: When Knowledge Becomes Infrastructure: How Enterprise AI Redistributes Organizational Power
title_zh: 當知識成為基礎設施：企業 AI 如何重新分配組織權力
summary: Enterprise AI forces knowledge into machine-retrievable forms, relocating power from the people who know to the people who run the knowledge supply chain. Five publications examine the shift from knowledge possession to knowledge authority — and what leaders must decide before agents start acting on the answers.
summary_zh: 企業 AI 迫使知識以機器可檢索的形式存在，把權力由「知道的人」轉移到「營運知識供應鏈的人」手上。五種出版角度剖析這場由知識擁有轉向知識權威的轉移——以及在大規模部署之前，領導層必須先回答的治理問題。
